rules.wrapper: Close one leading <answer> tag only when no other markup occurs. For MIRA, wrap a nonempty bare answer. Never change answer content.
rules.truncation: Do not repair wrappers on token-limit outputs; MathVista numeric extraction rejects token-limit outputs.
rules.mathvista_numeric: Extract exactly one finite number for free-form integer/float questions. Ignore units, percent/currency signs and valid thousands separators; preserve sign, decimals and scientific notation.
rules.mathvista_magnitude: Preserve the stated magnitude: 51.04% becomes 51.04. No unit conversion, arithmetic evaluation or selection among multiple numbers.
rules.choice: After strict parsing fails, accept an in-range letter tag, a letter with matching public option text (including numeric-equivalent text), or a unique option text. Reject conflicting letter/text. For image-only label options A/B/C/D, accept one leading explicit label with explanation, without competing answer labels.
rules.compact_sets: For letter-set tasks, split a whole uppercase compact payload such as AB into A,B only if every character is a public piece label.
rules.compact_actions: For grid/sliding tasks, split a whole UDLR compact payload such as RDD into R,D,D. Preserve action order and repetitions; execute the full normalized sequence with the existing task rules.
rules.reasoning: A single final answer block may follow reasoning; never select letters or numbers from intermediate reasoning. Do not extend repair to outputs that reached the token limit.
rules.other_answers: Keep MathVista numeric_v1, rotation, action-execution and MIRA content checks. Do not supply missing fields or use reference answers to extract a prediction.
rules.provenance: Save original prediction text, wrapper transformation, template version/hash, effective policies and scoring code hashes. Compare models using the same template.
